messages:
maria: Quick update  vendor payment terms standardizing to Net30 effective June 1. Exceptions: critical infra vendors and managed services can keep Net45 if procurement approves. Please review below.

ton y: Why the change? any impact on virtual cards?

maria: Mainly to simplify cash flow forecasting and reduce manual follow-ups. Virtual cards remain approved for ad-hoc purchases under $5k and will still pay out on issuance. Use the VC first for card-eligible spend.

zara: What about existing contracts with Net60?

maria: Existing contracts honored until renewal. At renewal procurement will negotiate toward Net30 or secure exec approval to keep Net60 for strategic cases. Add notes to the contract renewal ticket.

proc-bot: Vendor update REQ-2047 received re: AtlasDB renewal. Status: queued for procurement review.

kevin: Small ops note  vendors needing expedited onboarding (security/access) can trigger a fast-track payment terms review. Tag ticket with `fastpay` and procurement aims to respond within 48 hours.

maria: Process recap: 1) For new vendors, default Net30; 2) For >$50k, attach 2 approvers and budget line; 3) For emergency infra spend use EPR flow (see #finance for template).

zara: Thanks  publishing a Confluence blurb now and will auto-email vendors with upcoming changes next week.

maria: Governance: do not split invoices to bypass thresholds. Any irregularities will be flagged and may delay vendor payments.

proc-bot: REQ-2047 status update: assigned to procurement (maria).
